text:
The Grand Chamber of the European Court of Human Rights held in Al-Adsani v. United Kingdom (2001) that the UK's grant of state immunity to Kuwait in a torture damages claim did not violate the applicant's right of access to a court under Article 6(1). The Court found that state immunity remained a legitimate restriction on that right and that no exception for torture had yet crystallized in international law. The application was therefore dismissed.
CONFIDENCE: 95
